text_block_list.text:
Мэйсё Дото joins Т.М. Опера О to
watch the
previous generation race in
the Derby.

Спешл Уик emerges the winner
among this
collection of highly talented
runners. There's no
confusion as to why
they're known as the Ultimate

Generation.

Seeing her own skills as nonexistent in

comparison, Мэйсё Дото flies into a
panic.

With a stern scolding by Т.М. Опера О,
Meisho
Doto comes back to her senses.
She looks to her
upcoming debut race
with extraordinary gusto.
